metadata.observation: known base/goal relative coordinates + ideal odometry + local raycast voxel projection; no global map or gate labels
metadata.reward: delivered fixed value / 4: near=0.25, far=1; timeout/fall=0; one delivery per episode
metadata.cargo: Known fixed values 1 and 4; identical unloaded dynamics; logical loading; higher-value contact upgrades cargo, never downgrades it
metadata.trial: two independent Bernoulli gates sampled once; unchanged over 3 episodes; deadline fixed within trial
metadata.backend: Genesis 0.4.6 + frozen Full_8000 unloaded locomotion + first-hit lidar
metadata.reset: step ends an episode; next_episode keeps hidden gates; reset starts a new trial

controller: Hand-specified static-layout waypoint controller with actual ray evidence; no learned policy
caveat: Single demonstration seed for deadline checks; measured scripted feasibility, not shortest-path bounds
